# splunkctl apps

Manage Splunk apps.

## apps get

Get app details.

```text
splunkctl apps get [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## apps install

Install an app from a local .tar.gz or .spl file.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl apps install [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Uploads via Splunk Web UI — works from a remote client without
SSH access to the server.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | file | - | Path to .tar.gz or .spl package. [required] |
| `--force` | flag | false | Overwrite if app already exists. |

## apps list

List installed apps.

```text
splunkctl apps list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## apps reload

Reload all apps.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl apps reload [OPTIONS]
```

## apps uninstall

Uninstall an app.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl apps uninstall [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## apps update

Update app settings.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl apps update [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--visible / --hidden` | flag | - | Set app visibility. |
| `--enabled / --disabled` | flag | - | Enable or disable the app. |
